scope: Read-only local core-source audit; not emulator or hardware recovery acceptance
findings: EP147 reads persistent az-preload.env at first start, before the USB loader service runs.
az-usbload lines1203-1216 preserve a cached running mod set when the USB is absent; the stock environment is staged for Reload or a later boot.
The source therefore does not guarantee absence of cached candidate activation on the first USB-less boot.
A mod-level fail-closed initialization using supported USB asset availability is under review; it has not been implemented or accepted by this audit.
required_follow_up: Verify the supported asset API reports actual USB availability rather than internal staged executable presence.
Test normal-loader populated-cache first boot with the USB removed, including first application start and settled state.
Verify the applicable real loader and physical removal/full-restart behavior before real candidate activation.
limits: The deployed real-AZ loader version has not been matched to this local checkout.
Current emulator transient-service launch does not reproduce normal boot ordering.
No real device operations or internal system changes were performed.
